CORE MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #6
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 50
   C. 49
   D. 14

2. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 400
   C. 4
   D. 40

3. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 3
   C. 15
   D. 21

4. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 10
   C. 2
   D. 25

5. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 122
   B. 121
   C. 11
   D. 22

6. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 25
   C. 11
   D. 5

7. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 10
   C. 4
   D. 40

8. Solve for x: x + 8 = 14. (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 6
   C. 7
   D. 14

9. Which list shows all factors of 6? (1 mark)
   A. 3, 6, 9
   B. 1, 2, 3, 6
   C. 2, 4, 6
   D. 1, 6

10. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 41
   B. 40
   C. 13
   D. 3

11. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 37
   C. 13
   D. 36

12. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 000 m²
   B. 10 000 m²
   C. 100 m²
   D. 1000 m²

13. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 24
   C. 42
   D. 36

14. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 18
   C. 90
   D. 36

15. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 16
   C. 0
   D. 17

16. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 12
   C. 4
   D. 33

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
